name: rex-sesh
title: Rex Sesh
description: Smart session manager for Rex, inspired by sesh. Combines live Rex sessions, configured sessions, and zoxide directories.
author: xheisenbugx

commands.name: sessions
commands.title: Search Sessions
commands.subtitle: Rex Sesh
commands.description: Connect to a live Rex session, or create one from a configured session or zoxide directory.

preferences.name: shortcutConnectWithOptions
preferences.title: Shortcut: Create with Options
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Create with Options”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+shift+enter. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutRename
preferences.title: Shortcut: Rename Session
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Rename Session”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+e. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutKill
preferences.title: Shortcut: Kill Session
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Kill Session”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for ctrl+x. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutTogglePreview
preferences.title: Shortcut: Toggle Preview
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Toggle Preview”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+shift+p. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutNewSession
preferences.title: Shortcut: New Session
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “New Session”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+n. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutRefresh
preferences.title: Shortcut: Refresh
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Refresh”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+shift+r. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutShowInFinder
preferences.title: Shortcut: Show in Finder
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Show in Finder”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+o. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutCopyPath
preferences.title: Shortcut: Copy Path
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Copy Path”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+shift+c. Enter none to turn it off.

preferences.name: shortcutEditConfig
preferences.title: Shortcut: Edit Config
preferences.description: Keyboard shortcut for “Edit Config”, e.g. cmd+shift+p, ctrl+x or ⌘⇧P. Leave empty for cmd+shift+,. Enter none to turn it off.

commands.name: create-session
commands.title: Create Session
commands.subtitle: Rex Sesh
commands.description: Create a Rex session in a chosen directory.

commands.name: next-session
commands.title: Next Session
commands.subtitle: Rex Sesh
commands.description: Switch the Rex app to the next session.

commands.name: previous-session
commands.title: Previous Session
commands.subtitle: Rex Sesh
commands.description: Switch the Rex app to the previous session.

preferences.name: rexPath
preferences.title: Rex CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the rex binary. Leave empty to auto-detect.

preferences.name: configPath
preferences.title: Config File
preferences.description: sesh-compatible TOML config. Defaults to ~/.config/rex-sesh/sesh.toml, falling back to ~/.config/sesh/sesh.toml.

preferences.name: client
preferences.title: Rex Client
preferences.description: Label or ID of the Rex app to control. Leave empty to use the first connected app.

preferences.name: showZoxide
preferences.title: Sources
preferences.label: Show zoxide directories
preferences.description: Include zoxide directories in the list.

preferences.name: showPreview
preferences.label: Show preview panel by default
preferences.description: Show a terminal / directory preview beside the list.

preferences.name: useDefaultStartup
preferences.label: Run default startup command
preferences.description: Run [default_session].startup_command in new sessions that have no command of their own.
